lo_assumption: differential rail-to-rail CMOS square LO, 50% duty, 30 ps edges, 50 ohm source, 2.44 GHz
pad_assumption: 2 ohm + 1 pF per leg (rftxpad allocation); unmatched benches: 100 nH bias-tee chokes to the island rail, DC-blocked 50 ohm differential load

board_match.method: board DC feed to the rf_tx island rail through per-leg chokes (Q=30) that resonate the measured differential pad susceptance (tt, code 15, driver biased by the feed); DC blocks; ideal 200:50 ohm balun followed by a 1.0 dB resistive pad for balun insertion loss; 50 ohm load. All board-matched powers are after the balun loss.
